decisions.statement: A ring is one of two sizes.
The small ring is the size three small rings span a small tile at.
The large ring fills a small tile alone.
Every arc starts at twelve o'clock and sweeps clockwise.
The figure sits inside the ring and the label below that ring.
A ring leaves slack above its label rather than taking every point the label does not.
The emoji a ring draws in place of itself is drawn at the size the ring draws rather than is given.

definition: a reading drawn as an arc around the figure it reads
